messages.text: Our dad died and left the house in his will. My sister A wants to buy it with her husband at a "family discount". I'm not signing off on that. Our younger sister B could use some money too. Can you help us sort this out?

I don’t have the will wording; C said Dad left the house in his will. I don’t know the mortgage, debts, value, or any offer. My main concern is whether my husband and I can buy the house at a family discount. I’d accept exploring that if C agrees and the terms are clear. Yes, I agree to pause signing until the checks are done.

1. I don’t have the exact wording; I’m not sure who has a copy.  
2. I don’t know the mortgage, debts, value, or offer.  
3. My main concern is having money to start a dance studio.  
4. I could accept a fair plan that makes that possible, though I don’t know what the shares or amounts should be.  
5. Yes, I agree to pause signing until the checks are done.

I don’t have the will wording, handler’s name, mortgage or debt details, value, or an offer. I don’t know who can obtain them; the person handling Dad’s will may be able to provide the wording and financial details, and an independent valuer can assess the house. I can’t confirm C’s agreement for her.

I don’t have the will wording, handler’s name, or mortgage, debt, value, or offer details. The person handling Dad’s will may be able to provide the wording and financial details; an independent property expert could assess the value. I only know A wants to buy the house.
I don’t have the exact wording, know who has a copy or who’s handling Dad’s will, or have the mortgage, debt, value, or offer details. I don’t know who can obtain them yet. I agree to pause signing.
I can contact the person handling Dad’s will, a lawyer, and an independent valuer. I don’t yet have their names or any new facts.
I can contact them and gather the details, if that works for everyone. I don’t have any new facts yet.
I’m fine with both A and B gathering the facts. That doesn’t mean I agree to a discounted purchase.
B and I will work together; I don’t have any facts yet. C, no need to reply unless you have new facts or object. The next list update will go to all three of us.

I’ll work with A to request the documents and independent advice, and share the same information. I don’t have any facts to add yet. C needn’t reply unless she has new facts or objects; the next update will go to all three.
No new facts from me. I don’t object to A and B gathering them; I still haven’t agreed to a discounted purchase.
B and I will work together to gather the information and share it with C and you. We don’t have any new facts yet.
I don’t have any new facts yet. I’ll work with A to request the documents and independent advice, and share what we find with C and you.
No new facts, and I don’t object to gathering them. I still do not agree to a discounted purchase.
